descriptions: Dataset used in the flood vulnerability workflow discussed in the PhD thesis "Characterising housing stock vulnerability to floods by combining UAV, Mapillary and survey data - A case study for the Karonga district in Malawi" and subsequently used to audit the same workflow. Please see the README file for more details.
